method: 60 real seconds per run, 60 identical synthetic snapshots; isolated real draft service and Chromium 390x844; 4x CPU throttle; 200 backups, 100 events, 5000 log lines; SSE stopped for render isolation.
limitations: Before overlapped the full browser suite; timing values are diagnostic samples, not a controlled speed comparison or field INP. DOM counts are from the same deterministic snapshot workload. Physical phone, browser background throttling and real PZ load not measured here.
